doc.description: This module is an alternative to the original orange avoider for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at TU Delft. It uses a neural network-based depth model (exported from PyTorch in ONNX format) to compute a depth map from the drone's front camera. The depth map is then processed using a potential fields method to compute a repulsive heading adjustment based on the detected number and location of high-valued (red) pixels, which indicate obstacles. It also moves waypoints forward when the path is clear.
